Toddler meals

Crustless spinach egg bake

Zöldséges tojásos tál

10 months+ Replaced 35 min 4 portions

Serve warm from ten months, in soft pieces. There is no pastry case.

Freezes well.

Ingredients

  • 4 Eggs (Beaten)
  • 100 ml Full-fat milk (Pasteurized)
  • 80 g Spinach (Washed, wilted, and chopped)
  • 30 g Mild cheese (Pasteurized, grated)

Allergens

eggmilk

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
  2. Wilt the spinach, squeeze it, and chop it.
  3. Beat the eggs with the milk, then stir in the spinach and cheese.
  4. Pour into a small dish with no pastry crust.
  5. Bake until the egg is set and the centre is firm, about 22 minutes.
  6. Cool slightly and cut into soft pieces.

Replaced

The pastry quiche was the problem. Pastry, cream, and salty cheese are not the meal to serve.

Bake a crustless mix of egg, milk, spinach, and a little mild cheese until the egg is set. Offer it from ten months.
